thread:
sarah: Scheduling Kappa Health (private) rollout for v2.3.1 tomorrow 02:00 UTC. 4h change window. Canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 15m stabilization. Rollback triggers: error-rate >= 3% for 2 consecutive windows or p95 latency > 750ms. Pinning command below. Asking for on-call / SRE / security ack. @carlos @megan @oliver @rj_oncall

deploy-bot: Preflight checks: infra health OK, reserved GPUs available, docker images verified, smoke tests passed (3/3). Auto-canary schedule created. Audit ID: rbw-202-proceed

carlos: quick Q — KMS rotation for Kappa is scheduled same day at 04:30 UTC per ops calendar. That collides with our tail window. Can we shift rotation or change rollout window?

sarah: good catch. Ops said rotation is flexible within +/-6h. Recommendation: keep rollout at 02:00 and ask ops to move KMS rotation to 08:00. I'll ping ops now.

megan: nit — KV cache will be cold. Plan to prefill prefixes for top 10 tenants? we can prefill using the prefill job. If not, expect higher early latency for first 20m.

oliver: fallback plan if Dedicated pool gets saturated: route ~20% traffic to quantized v2.3.1-q8 on different slice. Does that exist for Kappa?

sarah: yes, v2.3.1-q8 is available as compatible variant. We'll include a routing policy: dedicated -> fallback-q8 if capacity < 30% free. I'll add that to the rollout plan.

megan: also add note to release notes that embeddings model unchanged. Some client batch jobs expect old response sizes.

security-bot: KMS status check: key/kappa-prod is ACTIVE. No pending rotations but 04:30 event exists in calendar (user-submitted). Recommend ops confirmation before move.

carlos: small ask on rollbacks — include explicit runbook snippet in the thread so SREs don't have to dig.

sarah: copying runbook snippet here:
```
# emergency rollback to last stable
redwood rollback --tenant kappa-health --to-version v2.2.5 --force --reason "rollback: latency spike"
# cut traffic immediately
redwood route update --tenant kappa-health --variant v2.2.5 --weight 100
# notify slack and oncall
```

oliver: thanks. Also recommend enabling short term 5s cooldown on canary scale-ups to observe KV cache fill.

rj_oncall: I can move KMS rotation to 08:00 UTC. Ops confirmed. rj_oncall: +1 for rollout as proposed, please ensure deploy-runbook pinned and testing panel up.

megan: ack — will run prefill job 90m before canary start and monitor p95.

carlos: ack :thumbsup: — SRE approves monitoring thresholds and runbook.

security-bot: Confirmed: KMS rotation moved to 08:00 UTC. Audit log updated.

sarah: recording approvals. Pin command for deploy team: `redwood deploy pin --tenant kappa-health --version v2.3.1 --schedule "2026-03-21T02:00:00Z"`

sarah: final ask: @deploy-bot please create the canary with staged weights [5,25,100] and apply routing fallback to v2.3.1-q8 on capacity pressure. Include bake alerts to ops channel and pager rules.

deploy-bot: Canary created: canary-id cb-1769. Weights scheduled: 5%@02:00 -> 25%@02:30 -> 100%@03:00. Fallback rule attached. Bake alerts: eng-oncall and eng-sre.

rj_oncall: final go from oncall. I'll be on shift during rollout.

sarah: marking thread as APPROVED and locking change window. I'll push release notes to docs and attach to ticket. Thanks team. :rocket:

megan: quick follow — I'll post a short smoke checklist to the ticket, then ccing support for post-rollout validation.

carlos: noted — will watch metrics during rollout.

sarah: thanks all — closing out here. If anything changes ping me and we'll pause.
